Alerts

Warning events from the last hour, grouped by the pod, node or volume they concern. For control-plane and worker nodes it also includes errors from the last 48 hours of the kubelet and kernel logs and the control-plane pod logs (API server, etcd, scheduler, controller manager), because Kubernetes keeps events for only one hour.
